comparison.objective: Remove a binder clip from invoices and feed the paper safely into a shredder.
comparison.physical_skill: Supporting a thin stack, opening/removing a sprung clip, edge-on slot alignment, and guarded feeding.
comparison.success_condition: Paper is shredded, clip remains outside and safely placed, fingers stay out of the slot, and hands withdraw; feeding the clip or unsafe insertion permanently fails.
comparison.reason: The task tests fastener removal and narrow-slot feeding, not agitation-based particle/workpiece separation. No comparison-critical detail is missing.
